title: Our market
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names people found in a market and says what each one does.
steps: Say who pays and who sells.
contexts: a fish market at the lake

board.do: Draw a seller, a buyer and a porter with sacks.
Wait for the child to say carries goods.

misconceptions.ask: Name a person in a market who is not a seller.
misconceptions.repair: Act out a market with sellers, buyers, porters and a cleaner.

misconceptions.ask: A man carries sacks for a trader. What is his job?
misconceptions.repair: Show a porter being paid to carry. Name the job.

misconceptions.ask: Who gives the money when you buy tomatoes?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play with play money: the buyer pays, the seller gives the goods and change.

listen_for: Yes, it is there for everyone
misconceptions.ask: Can you take a banana from a market stall without paying?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play buying. Say: taking without paying is stealing.

skills.key_step: The child lists foods sold in a market and sorts them into fruits and vegetables.

floor.question: Put all the round things together.

steps: Name foods sold in the market.
Sort them into fruits and vegetables.
Draw a fruit and a vegetable.

board.do: Draw a mango, sukuma wiki, an orange and a cabbage.
Wait for the child to say vegetable.
Put each in the right basket.

listen_for: A vegetable, it is not sweet
misconceptions.ask: Is an avocado a fruit or a vegetable?
misconceptions.repair: Cut an avocado and a mango: both have a seed inside and grow on trees. Call both fruits as the class chart does.

listen_for: No, we can eat it raw
misconceptions.repair: Show raw and cooked carrots. It is still a carrot, still a vegetable.

misconceptions.ask: Name a food from an animal sold in the market.
misconceptions.repair: Show pictures of a butchery and a fish stall in a market.

listen_for: A fruit, it is green like an orange
misconceptions.ask: Is sukuma wiki a fruit or a vegetable?
misconceptions.repair: Sort by what part we eat: leaves are vegetables; sweet or seeded parts from trees are fruits.

checks.question: Name a fruit sold in the market.
Is cabbage a fruit or a vegetable?
